title: Cedar: Old Cedars You Can Visit
meta_description: Cedars whose species is still open. In Bron, two Lyon records call the town hall cedar a Lebanon cedar and the survey that measured it calls it Atlas.
intro: These cedars carry only their genus, Cedrus, because nobody has settled which cedar each one is, and in two cases the official records argue with themselves. Two documents of the Lyon Métropole call the cedar on the Place de Weingarten in Bron a Cedar of Lebanon, and the 2024 survey that measured it at 383 centimetres round wrote down Atlas cedar. The pair on the Square de Villevert at Albigny-sur-Saône split the same way, and the bigger trunk there is 461 centimetres round. The rest came from readers. One stood under a cedar in Livorno's Villa Fabbricotti whose drooping sprays look like a deodar's. Others sent cedars from a university campus in Varese and the park of Villa Cagnola as Lebanon, Atlas or plain cedars, and the photographs settle none of it. Verona's, in Piazza Indipendenza, came in as a Himalayan cedar. Tell us if you can read a cedar by its cones.
